tagline.en_US: Create and manage databases through a spreadsheet-style web interface. This single-image profile uses NocoDB’s SQLite quickstart mode.

description.en_US: NocoDB is a no-code database platform that provides a spreadsheet-style interface for managing relational databases. It allows users to create, read, update, and delete tables, rows, and columns with custom sorting, filtering, and role-based permissions. Data can be displayed across various formats including grid, gallery, form, kanban, and calendar views.
